ath_note: Monthly ATH rules on ETFs and funds (2016-26 tests): Indian mutual funds 3-8%/yr vs 11-14% buy-and-hold (few signals, whipsaw exits and exit loads); US and ASX stocks showed no edge with these rules; ETFs not separately tested. Watch only.
backtest_global: US/ASX SIP test 2005-26 (same rules): 20%-below top-up vs plain SIP: S&P 500 +0.2%/yr, Nasdaq 100 -0.5%, Russell 2000 +0.3%, ASX 200 +0.1%; 30% trigger: S&P -0.7%, Nasdaq -0.9%. Essentially no gain outside India.
backtest: SIP test 2016-26 (same total money, 50% of each SIP kept in a liquid fund and deployed when the index is 20-30% below its high): Nifty +0.6 to +1.7%/yr XIRR, Midcap 150 +0.2 to +1.5%, Smallcap 250 +0.2%; gold worse with every rule; shallower triggers (10% below the high, below the 200-day average) added nothing. Bottom patterns: no edge (watch only).
